processing: OPeNDAP CSV subsets of SPL3SMP_E 006 (one granule per day, UTC day of the file name)
fill -9999 and values outside the valid range 0.02-0.5 cm3/cm3 -> missing; flag fill 65534 -> missing

placed on the 30 m farm grid by nearest: each 30 m cell takes the 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 cell containing it (cell bounds halfway between the granule's published cell centres, read once from a coordinate probe of EASE rows/cols (800, 920, 1000, 1150)); coarse value kept coarse
AM and PM retrievals kept separate; no gap filling, no temporal compositing
provenance.notes: retrieval_qual_flag as published (bit meanings per the SPL3SMP_E product documentation; not interpreted here). Missing granule days: none.
